Source summary: Magna Carta states, in medieval legal language, that certain free men should not be imprisoned or dispossessed except through lawful judgment or the law of the land. This is an instructional paraphrase of Clause 39, not a quotation. A parliamentary record shows monarchs seeking consent for taxation; a chronicle perspective presents warfare and loyalty through the author’s political viewpoint.
